import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_rng structure
class GSLRng(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Define the function prototypes
# gsl_rng_alloc allocates memory for the random number generator
# gsl_rng_set sets the seed for the random number generator
# gsl_rng_uniform generates a random double between 0 and 1

# Allocate the random number generator
gsl_rng_alloc = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc
gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng)

# Free the random number generator
gsl_rng_free = gsl.gsl_rng_free
gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng)]
gsl_rng_free.restype = None

# Set the seed
gsl_rng_set = gsl.gsl_rng_set
gsl_rng_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng), ctypes.c_ulong]
gsl_rng_set.restype = None

# Generate a random double
gsl_rng_uniform = gsl.gsl_rng_uniform
gsl_rng_uniform.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng)]
gsl_rng_uniform.restype = ctypes.c_double

# Function to generate a random double
def generate_random_double(seed):
    # Get the default random number generator type
    gsl_rng_default = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, 'gsl_rng_default')

    # Allocate the random number generator
    rng = gsl_rng_alloc(gsl_rng_default)
    if not rng:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate memory for the random number generator")

    try:
        # Set the seed
        gsl_rng_set(rng, seed)

        # Generate a random double
        random_double = gsl_rng_uniform(rng)
        return random_double
    finally:
        # Free the random number generator
        gsl_rng_free(rng)

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test with a specific seed
    seed = 123456
    random_double = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert 0 <= random_double <= 1, "Random double is out of bounds"

    # Test with another seed
    seed = 789012
    random_double = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert 0 <= random_double <= 1, "Random double is out of bounds"

    # Test with zero seed
    seed = 0
    random_double = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert 0 <= random_double <= 1, "Random double is out of bounds"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
